comment: Coverage that is not a direct reference from a test source. protocols: runner checks of scripts/ci/native_platforms.py that exercise the function natively on every platform. unsupported: per-platform technical reason. not_testable: why no native test can call the function.

kiso/net/tcp.*.windows-amd64: kiso/aot/lowerwinrt has no Winsock layer: the socket runtime of lowerlinux (Linux socket syscalls) has no Windows implementation yet, so the calls stop with the explicit runtime error "unsupported operation"
